vessels.name: Large Bowl
vessels.reuse: Autolyse → dough → bulk ferment → cold retard

states.title: Combine Flour and Milk
states.direction: In large bowl, combine flour and warm milk (43°C/110°F). Mix with rubber spatula until no dry flour remains. Dough will be shaggy.
states.exit_condition: No dry flour visible, shaggy mass formed

states.title: Rest (Autolyse)
states.direction: Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Let rest at room temperature.
states.exit_condition: 30 minutes elapsed, dough is relaxed and slightly smoother

notes.text: Autolyse hydrates flour and begins gluten development without kneading

states.title: Add Yeast
states.direction: Sprinkle yeast and 25g sugar over dough. Mix with rubber spatula, then squeeze and fold dough to incorporate.
states.exit_condition: Yeast and sugar evenly distributed throughout dough

notes.text: Reduced yeast from 12g to 9g - long ferment needs less

states.title: Add Salt and Butter
states.direction: Add salt and 28g softened butter. Squeeze and fold dough until fully incorporated.
states.exit_condition: No butter streaks visible, dough is cohesive

notes.text: Butter should be soft but not melted for this method

states.title: Develop Gluten
states.direction: In bowl, stretch and fold dough: grab one side, stretch up, fold over center. Rotate 90° and repeat. Do 4 folds total (one full rotation).
states.exit_condition: Dough is smooth and elastic, pulls back when stretched

states.title: Bulk Ferment
states.direction: Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Let rise at room temperature.
states.exit_condition: Dough has risen ~50%, looks puffy with some bubbles

notes.text: Time varies with room temperature. Look for 50% rise, not exact time.

states.title: Stretch and Fold
states.direction: Perform another set of 4 stretch-and-folds in the bowl. This strengthens gluten and redistributes yeast.
states.exit_condition: Dough is tighter and more elastic than before

states.title: Refrigerate Overnight
states.direction: Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 8-12 hours (overnight).
states.exit_condition: Next morning, dough is cold, slightly risen, with developed flavor

notes.text: Dough can stay refrigerated up to 24 hours if needed
END OF DAY 1 - Continue tomorrow morning

states.title: Temper Dough
states.direction: Remove dough from refrigerator. Let sit at room temperature while you prepare filling and equipment.
states.exit_condition: Dough is pliable but still cool, not room temperature

notes.text: Don't let it warm completely - cool dough is easier to roll

states.title: Make Filling Mixture
states.direction: In small bowl, combine brown sugar, 14g melted butter, 50g granulated sugar, cinnamon, cloves, and 0.75g salt. Mix until uniform.
states.exit_condition: Mixture is evenly combined with no dry pockets

states.title: Roll and Apply Filling
states.direction: On lightly floured surface, roll dough into 30×23 cm rectangle with long side facing you. Brush with 28g melted butter, leaving 1cm border. Sprinkle filling mixture evenly, leaving 2cm border at top edge. Press filling lightly to adhere.
states.exit_condition: Filling evenly distributed and pressed into butter

notes.text: Cold dough may need extra rolling - let it relax if it springs back

states.title: Roll Into Cylinder
states.direction: Starting from long edge nearest you, roll dough away into tight cylinder, tucking as you go. Pinch seam and ends closed. Adjust to 30cm length with even diameter.
states.exit_condition: Tight, even cylinder with sealed seam on bottom

notes.text: Keep roll taut—loose rolls cause gaps in finished buns

states.title: Cut and Arrange
states.direction: Grease skillet with 14g butter. Using serrated knife, cut cylinder into 8 equal pieces (~4cm each). Arrange cut-side down in skillet: 1 in center, 7 around edge.

states.title: Final Proof
states.direction: Cover skillet loosely with plastic wrap. Let rise at room temperature until buns are puffy and touching.
states.exit_condition: Buns have expanded significantly and are touching each other

notes.text: Start preheating oven 20 minutes before proof is done
May take 45-75 min depending on room temperature

states.title: Prep for Oven
states.direction: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) with rack in middle position. Remove plastic wrap. Brush bun tops with 28g melted butter.
states.exit_condition: Oven preheated, buns brushed, plastic removed

states.title: Bake
states.direction: Transfer skillet to oven. Bake, rotating skillet halfway through.
states.exit_condition: Buns are deep golden brown, filling is bubbling

notes.text: Skillet handle will be extremely hot—use potholders!
Rotate at 13-14 minute mark for even browning

states.title: Cool
states.direction: Transfer skillet to wire rack. Let cool.
states.exit_condition: Buns are warm but not molten-hot

notes.text: Filling is molten—eating too soon will burn mouth

states.title: Make Glaze
states.direction: In medium bowl, whisk cream cheese, confectioners' sugar, 28g melted butter, 30g milk, vanilla, and 0.75g salt until smooth.
states.exit_condition: Smooth, pourable glaze with no lumps

notes.text: Can make during COOL step to save time

states.title: Glaze Buns
states.direction: Spread glaze evenly over warm buns. Serve immediately.
